teaser.en: Break a stem and white 'milk' wells up; the Digo name means exactly that.
teaser.sw: Vunja shina na 'maziwa' meupe hububujika; jina la Kidigo lina maana hiyo hasa.

summary.en: *Chiziyaziya*, asthma weed, is a small hairy weed that oozes white latex when broken. Pakia records its latex as medicinal.
summary.sw: *Chiziyaziya* (asthma weed) ni gugu dogo lenye manyoya linalotoa utomvu mweupe likivunjwa. Pakia anaripoti kwamba utomvu wake ni dawa.

about.en: Asthma weed is a small, hairy annual herb, usually sprawling or rising to about 40 cm, with reddish stems. Its opposite, oval, toothed leaves are often blotched with purple. Tiny greenish to reddish flowers are packed into dense round clusters at the leaf joints. Every part contains white milky latex. Digo identify it by its leaves and its latex.
about.sw: *Euphorbia hirta* ni mmea mdogo wa msimu mmoja wenye manyoya, ambao kwa kawaida hutambaa au hukua hadi takriban sentimita 40, na una mashina ya rangi nyekundu. Majani yake ya umbo la yai, yenye meno kingoni na yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, mara nyingi huwa na madoa ya zambarau. Maua madogo sana ya kijani hadi mekundu hujazana katika vishada vizito vya mviringo kwenye vifundo vya majani. Kila sehemu ina utomvu mweupe kama maziwa. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani na utomvu wake.

where.en: It is one of the commonest weeds of the tropics, growing on paths, compounds, farms and roadsides.
where.sw: Ni mojawapo ya magugu yaliyoenea zaidi katika tropiki, yakiota njiani, viamboni, mashambani na kando ya barabara.

uses.en: Pakia notes that its latex is medicinal, but doesn't say what it is used for. Across the tropics the plant is widely used in folk medicine, notably for asthma and other breathing complaints (hence the English name), for diarrhoea, and with the latex applied to warts and sores.
uses.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba utomvu wake ni dawa, lakini hasemi hutumika kutibu nini. Katika nchi za tropiki mmea huu hutumika sana katika tiba asilia, hasa kwa pumu na matatizo mengine ya kupumua (ndiyo asili ya jina lake la Kiingereza), kwa kuhara, na utomvu wake hupakwa kwenye chunjua na vidonda.

culture.en: Pakia explains that its milky latex is called *maziya*, a word that goes back to 'milk'. *Maziya* is a harmless, milk-like sap, unlike the burning *ulimbo* of the tree euphorbias. Digo group plants with milky latex under the label *m/chiziya* ('milk'), together with the tree *mziyaziya* (*Hunteria zeylanica*) and the milk-cap mushroom *nimaziya*.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba utomvu wake mweupe huitwa *maziya*, neno linalotokana na 'maziwa'. *Maziya* ni utomvu usio na madhara unaofanana na maziwa, tofauti na *ulimbo* unaounguza wa mitupa mikubwa. Wadigo huweka mimea yenye utomvu mweupe katika kundi la *m/chiziya* ('maziwa'), pamoja na mti *mziyaziya* (*Hunteria zeylanica*) na uyoga wa maziwa *nimaziya*.

names.en: *Chiziyaziya* means 'milk', after the latex (*maziya*). The doubled stem *-ziyaziya* is shared by latex-producing plants, and *chi-* marks this one as small. Pakia also records the name *mbatata* but gives no meaning for it. The English name is asthma weed.
names.sw: *Chiziyaziya* maana yake 'maziwa', kutokana na utomvu wake (*maziya*). Shina lililorudiwa *-ziyaziya* hushirikiwa na mimea inayotoa utomvu, na *chi-* huonyesha kwamba huu ni mdogo. Pakia pia anarekodi jina *mbatata* lakini hatoi maana yake. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *asthma weed*.

reason.en: Hunteria zeylanica, mziyaziya, also a 'milk' plant
reason.sw: Hunteria zeylanica, mziyaziya, nao ni mmea wa 'maziwa'

reason.en: Milk-cap mushroom in the same 'milk' group
reason.sw: Uyoga wa maziwa katika kundi hilohilo la 'maziwa'

reason.en: Synadenium, a euphorbia with burning latex

definition.en: The harmless milky latex of this plant.
definition.sw: Utomvu mweupe kama maziwa, usio na madhara, wa mmea huu.
